transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

For the past eight months, I've been feeling this overwhelming amount of energy and an incredibly elevated, happy mood that just doesn't stop. I feel like I'm on top of the world, and I have this constant, unstoppable need to keep moving and doing things all the time. It's like my battery is always at one hundred percent, and I just can't seem to slow down.
During these periods of high energy, have you experienced any episodes of such extreme behavior or loss of control that you required hospitalization or were unable to function in your daily life?
I'm not really sure if it has reached the point of needing hospitalization, to be honest. But I do know that my energy and actions have felt incredibly intense and really hard to control lately.
Has this intense energy led to significant problems at work, school, or in your relationships, such as getting into trouble or causing major disruptions in your daily responsibilities?
I'm not really sure, and I haven't really thought about whether it has caused major problems for me. I just feel this overwhelming, constant need to keep busy and start new projects.
During these periods of high energy, have you ever felt that you had special powers, or heard voices or seen things that others could not perceive?

Yes, during these high-energy phases, I really do feel like I have a special, grand purpose and unique powers. I've also heard voices and seen things that others can't see or hear. But these unusual things only ever happen when my energy is overflowing like this.
